graft_ea_value_flow.persist_function: 0xfffffff00a1cada4 reads from source vnode [x19,#8] via 0xa23b13c (read EA): graft-vol-uuid (x2=0xbce3f6) -> apfs+0xf0; graft-jobj-id-base (0xbce412) -> sp+0x28 (8 bytes); graft-jobj-id-len (0xbce432) -> sp+0x20 (8 bytes)
graft_ea_value_flow.write_back: 0xa245df0 called with (apfs, vnode, flags, [x19,#0xb8], 'com.apple.fs.graft-vol-uuid', 1) - persists the graft record into the mount-private graft store
graft_ea_value_flow.store: graft records live in the apfs mount-private structure hash table at [apfs,#0xd50], count at [apfs,#0xd60]; apfs_mount_update (0xa2611e8) walks and persists them, logging 'failed to persist ephemeral grafts' on error
